text: Well, that's just a copy of the way I naturally walk, cause I'm a jazz, baby. Little jazz, baby, that's me. Rocked to sleep while a cradle went to and fro, to and fro, to the tune of the tickle-toe. Ever since I saw that in the grove, I loved to hear you sing.
